entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this VeloBand Pulse, and your company is making it impossible. This is completely unacceptable!
I can certainly look into that for you, and I'm sorry for any frustration. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
The name is Mark Peterson, order number VF88-1215-PULSE. I've had it for 20 days, and I want my money back now.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now. To make sure I'm helping correctly, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band, or is it more of a preference issue?
It doesn't matter what the issue is! I tried to return it on day nine, but your entire website was a joke! I got a massive 'website error' page. The whole system was down!
I understand. So you attempted to process the return online, but a system issue prevented it?

Yes! I couldn't print the label or even get to the return page. It was completely useless. I even took a screenshot to prove it. Now the system is telling me I'm past the return date. This is a scam! Get me your manager!

I can definitely take ownership of this for you, Mark. There's no need to escalate. I can confirm we did have a known system down event about ten or eleven days ago that affected our returns portal. I sincerely apologize for that.
An apology doesn't get me my money back! Are you going to fix this or am I going to have to write a review that'll make your head spin?

I understand your position completely. Let me just check the return policy for your item... one moment. Okay, I see you received it on December 15th. Looking at our policy here, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
See? 90 days! I knew it. So you're going to process this refund for me then?

Yes, absolutely. Since you're at day 20, you are well within that 90-day window. I've gone ahead and approved the return for you and overridden the system lock. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on file right now. Do you see it?
Hold on... yes, I just got it. About time. So just print this and send it back?
That's correct. Once we receive the VeloBand, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
No. That's all I needed. It shouldn't have been this hard.
I agree, and again, I apologize for the system issues you encountered. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
